program: iPSC-derived cortical neuron identity — fetal rather than adult signature
in_vitro_finding: iPSC-derived neurons express neuronal identity genes but their transcriptome (and 3D genome) most closely matches first/second-trimester fetal cortex; immature markers such as DCX remain high.
in_vivo_finding: Adult cortex has low DCX and an adult (not fetal) layer/maturation signature.
patient_finding: Adult patient post-mortem cortex: adult signature; iPSC models of adult-onset disease are therefore modelling a fetal-stage cell.
